text:
@bot has totally changed how our team operates….
Imagine having 10 of the best coworkers in one. We have a main @Bot that monitors the deal submissions inbox, picks up new deals, analyzes the models, builds the decks, and drafts approval emails for next steps . 
In two weeks we’ve worked through 40+ deals with 50%++ more efficiency 
Cannot imagine how I can work without it. Genuinely love the product, it really just makes life easier. Really crazy times
